description: This file defines a trait MultipartUploadingTrait used for handling multipart uploads to AWS S3, including methods to initialize upload state, handle upload results, determine part sizes, and configure upload parameters.

methods.name: getStateFromService
methods.description: Creates and returns an UploadState object for a multipart upload by querying S3 for the existing parts and their statuses.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Handles the result of a part upload, extracting ETag, and marking the part as uploaded in the upload state.

methods.name: getCompleteParams
methods.description: Generates parameters for completing the multipart upload, including uploaded parts information.

methods.name: determinePartSize
methods.description: Calculates and adjusts the size of parts for upload, ensuring it adheres to AWS size constraints.

methods.name: getInitiateParams
methods.description: Prepares parameters for initiating an upload, including ACL and ContentType.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the current UploadState.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve configuration parameters.

methods.name: getSourceSize
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the source data size.

methods.name: getSourceMimeType
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the MIME type of source data.
